hunks.sol: I wanted to drive my fist into that smug face of his, but I held myself back. Not because I was weaker than Jin Mukyung, but because I knew he was right.

hunks.sol: “Even a deaf old man knows the Third Young Master of the Jin Family of Taiyuan is a wastrel. Do you think Jopil didn’t? The moment he let his guard down, he was finished.”

hunks.baseline: “That luck of yours stops working here.”

hunks.sol: “The Murim is crawling with all kinds of monsters, and they won’t let their guard down like Jopil did. You’re no longer the Jin Family’s wastrel of a Third Young Master. You’re the Sleeping Dragon of Shanxi.”

hunks.sol: Not only had I discovered the problem early, but I had an excellent problem-solver standing right in front of me, ready to help fix it.

hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung flinched.

hunks.sol: “I’ve dreamed of this moment for years. The day I would finally stand behind you, Lesser Family Head!”

hunks.baseline: “Ah.”

hunks.sol: *I never imagined something like this would happen.*
